prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Polonium (Po) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Weather / season: spring — blossom petals drifting outside.
Light direction: two-colour light — warm indoor light on one side, cool daylight or dusk on the other.
Outfit: a backless column gown — in rich jewel tones such as emerald, sapphire, amethyst or wine red; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; right now — a splash of water has just soaked her clothes — the damp fabric clings to her body line and darkens in patches, a few wet strands of hair stick to her neck and cheek; the fabric stays opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: sitting on the ground.
SUPPORT: her back rests against the wall.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera slightly above, looking down at her; she is placed in the right third of the frame, open space of the place to her left; a second space shows beyond her through an opening — a door, an arch or a window.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with both hands she holds a small sealed capsule glowing faint blue and warm with its own heat in both hands in front of her — her own right hand holds one side, her own left hand holds the other side.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: one eye closed in a playful wink while the other stays open and bright, one mouth corner lifted in a small smile, brows relaxed.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — polonium: a rare silvery metal found in July 1898 by a husband-and-wife pair of chemists in pitchblende and named for Poland, the wife's homeland then erased from the map, so the world would not forget it; so fiercely radioactive that a small piece heats itself to hundreds of degrees and makes the air around it glow blue; polonium-210 lasts only 138 days before decaying into quiet lead; it once kept a rover warm through the long lunar night — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: petite, small-framed — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

observations: 1024x1536 verified; one main adult woman; painterly anime finish.
